title: QUIC RFC 9368 Version Information Parse-Failure Close Verification
verification_method: Focused RFC9368-S4-P3-S2-R01 requirement-home tests, RFC 9368 requirement-home tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers the RFC 9368 requirement that malformed peer Version Information parsing failures close the connection. It proves the transcript parser marks malformed version_information transport parameters as transport-parameter parse failures and the runtime closes locally with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR.
preconditions: The transport-parameter codec rejects malformed Version Information values.
The TLS transcript parser receives peer quic_transport_parameters during the handshake.
The connection runtime consumes fatal TLS updates through the local-close path.
expected_result: Malformed peer Version Information produces a fatal transcript step classified as a QUIC transport-parameter parse failure, the runtime local close uses TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR, the RFC 9368 requirement-home suite passes, SpecTrace JSON validates, generated coverage reports RFC9368-S4-P3-S2-R01 as traceable, and diff hygiene remains clean.
status_summary: Passed. Focused RFC9368-S4-P3-S2-R01 tests prove both parser classification and local TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR close behavior.
